description.en: Type of vehicle: Crane truck with flatbed Make: MAN Model: TGX 26.360 Year of manufacture: 2010 Starts at the time of documentation: Yes and rolls. Used until sale: Yes Technical data & equipment: Flatbed dimensions: Height: 200 cm Length: 710 cm Width: 250 cm Hydraulic supports on the flatbed. Rear part of the flatbed hydraulically extendable 1500 mm Crane: Make: Palfinger Model: PK 50002 EH Year of manufacture: 2009 Dimensions/reach according to information: 14,600 mm Started at the time of documentation: No Crane inspection: In need of inspection Condition & comments: Service light is on and the vehicle warns of lamp failure. Clutch smell is present, the clutch may need overhaul. Rusty rear brake discs and noise when braking. Noise from the steering. Crack in the taillight. Crack in side indicators. Driver's door is hanging. The crane has not been function tested at the time of documentation and needs to be inspected. Brakes: Disc brakes Suspension: Air suspension at the rear Tire size and tread depth: Axle 1: Pirelli 385/55R22.5 M+S – 17 mm Axle 2: Bridgestone 315/70R22.5 M+S – 13 mm Axle 3: Pirelli and BFGoodrich 385/55R22.5 M+S – 15 mm Rust, scuffs and scratches are present. See pictures for condition assessment.
